hero.headline: Your book deserves more than a finished manuscript.
hero.intro: From manuscript proofreading and professional book design to publishing preparation, Amazon listing optimization, and book marketing, I help authors prepare, present, and grow their books with greater confidence.

intro.title: A finished manuscript is an achievement. A finished book is a different kind of work.
body: You wrote the book. What usually remains is the part readers never see: a careful pass for spelling, punctuation, and consistency; an interior set properly for print and for screens; files prepared to the specifications of your publishing platform; a listing that explains the book clearly enough to be found and understood.
Those stages are craft, just as writing is. I work on them so that nothing about how your book is presented undermines what you wrote, and so you have someone to talk through the decisions with.

services.title: Manuscript Proofreading
services.lede: A careful final pass before readers meet your book.
services.problem: A manuscript can be finished and still carry mistakes that readers notice straight away: a name spelled two ways, a missing quotation mark, a repeated word.
services.receive: Your manuscript returned with corrections applied and any queries flagged for your decision, plus a short note on what was corrected and what still needs your attention.

services.title: Book Design & Formatting
services.lede: Interiors and covers built to be read comfortably and look professional.
services.problem: A well-written book can still look unfinished once it is laid out. Common causes are cramped margins, chapter openings that do not match, misplaced page numbers, or an eBook that reflows badly on a phone.
includes: Front matter and back matter formatting
services.receive: A designed interior prepared for your chosen trim size, an eBook file that displays properly across reading devices, and a cover in the files your publishing platform requires.

services.title: Publishing & Production Support
services.lede: Preparing your files for the platforms you are publishing on.
services.problem: Platforms can reject a file or print it badly for technical reasons, such as the wrong bleed, an interior built to the wrong trim size, or an eBook that fails conversion. The problem often only shows at upload.
services.receive: Print-ready and eBook files prepared to the specifications of your platform, with the setup checks completed before you upload.

services.title: Amazon Book Listing Optimization
services.lede: Making the book page explain the book properly.
services.problem: A listing can be live and still be weak: thin keywords, loose categories, a description that lists features instead of explaining the book, or no A+ Content where it would help.
services.receive: A diagnostic audit of the elements above, explained in plain language, followed by agreed implementation work if you choose to proceed.

services.title: Book Marketing & Visibility
services.lede: Promotional support that sits alongside a well-presented book.
services.problem: Promotion is harder to make work when the listing underneath it is unclear, and a good listing does not promote itself. The two jobs are related but separate.
services.receive: A clear view of where your book currently stands, and a set of promotional activities agreed with you rather than applied generically. Marketing work cannot guarantee rankings, reviews, or sales.

problems.title: Errors that survived revision
problems.body: A completed manuscript can still carry spelling, punctuation, and consistency errors that a reader notices within pages.

problems.title: An interior that looks untidy
problems.body: Page structure, margins, and chapter openings decide whether a book looks professionally made or assembled at home.

problems.title: Readability lost in layout
problems.body: Type size, line length, and spacing affect how comfortable the book is to hold and read, not just how it looks.

problems.title: Print specifications that fail
problems.body: Incorrect trim, bleed, or margins create production problems that only surface when the file reaches the platform.

problems.title: An eBook that misbehaves
problems.body: A file that reads well in print can reflow badly on a phone, break chapter breaks, or lose its formatting entirely.

problems.title: A listing that undersells the book
problems.body: A weak Amazon page can leave readers unsure what the book offers, even when the book itself is strong.

problems.title: Thin metadata and loose positioning
problems.body: Incomplete keywords, categories, and description limit how many of the right readers ever see the book.

problems.title: Promotion on a weak foundation
problems.body: Marketing is harder to make effective when the presentation underneath it is unclear or unfinished.

process.title: Share your book or project
process.text: Send the manuscript, the existing files, or simply the book link. A few details about genre, stage, and timing are enough to begin.

process.title: Discuss the scope
process.text: We agree on exactly what will be done, what you will receive, and when. If something outside my services is needed, I will say so before any work starts.

process.title: Complete the agreed work
process.text: The proofreading, design, preparation, or optimization work is carried out to the agreed scope, with questions raised as they come up rather than at the end.

process.title: Review and finalize
process.text: You review the work, request any reasonable adjustments, and receive the final files ready for your chosen publishing platform.

amazon.title: A better Amazon book listing starts with understanding what is holding it back.
amazon.intro: Your Amazon book page plays an important role in how readers discover and evaluate your book. I help authors examine and improve the key elements of their listings so the book is presented more clearly and positioned more effectively.

examine.title: Keywords
examine.body: Keyword relevance and the opportunities to align the listing with the terms potential readers actually search for.

examine.title: Categories
examine.body: Whether the selected categories represent the book and its intended audience appropriately.

examine.title: Book Description
examine.body: Clarity, structure, relevance, and whether the description communicates what the book offers.

examine.title: A+ Content
examine.body: Whether A+ Content is available and being used effectively to support the presentation.

examine.title: Author Page
examine.body: The author's Amazon presence, profile completeness, and consistency with the book itself.

examine.title: Book Positioning
examine.body: How clearly the book communicates its subject, audience, genre, and value.

steps.title: Diagnostic audit
steps.text: I examine the relevant elements of the listing and identify the areas that may need improvement. The audit changes nothing on your listing.

steps.title: Findings
steps.text: You receive a clear explanation of what is working, what is holding the listing back, and what could reasonably be changed.

steps.title: Optimization work
steps.text: If you decide to proceed, we agree the scope before anything is changed on your listing.

amazon.note: The audit does not include implementation, rewriting, keyword replacement, category changes, A+ Content creation, or ongoing marketing. No ranking, review count, or sales figure can be promised from listing work alone.

about: I am Stephen Olamide, an Author Growth Partner. My work is practical: improving the accuracy of a manuscript, designing an interior that reads well in print and on screen, preparing files for the publishing platform you have chosen, and making sure the book is presented clearly once it is live.
I work with self-published and first-time authors, established authors revisiting an existing book, and coaches, speakers, pastors, educators, and professionals publishing nonfiction.
